R10.implementation: Each stage returns parse status before fallback; counters use the pre-fallback boolean, and fallback_used/fallback_reason are persisted.
R10.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R16.implementation: Both parsers use the shared complete canonical full-name/abbreviation matcher; ambiguity and candidate violations fail explicitly.
R16.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R17.implementation: The two CodeLlama wrappers call shared full-template encoding with add_special_tokens=False, preventing template BOS from being added twice.
R17.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R19.implementation: Gemma2 few-shot points to gemma-2-9b-it and checks actual config.model_type == gemma2; no historical checkpoint identity is inferred.
R19.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R22.implementation: Source identity, full original record, CSV hash, row index and raw gold are recorded for future runs.
R22.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R23.implementation: GPT-OSS generation preserves full new token stream; final extraction is delegated to the shared validated Harmony parser, rather than assistantfinal string splitting.
R23.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R24.implementation: Full input is encoded without truncation. The original requested output cap remains an upper bound; actual effective cap is min(requested, finite context-input tokens-64), with both values and any adjustment recorded. Only exhausted input/context budgets are rejected.
R24.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R28.implementation: The fine-stage format example is always taken from allowed[0], so AWR and all other routes have an in-candidate example.
R28.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R29.implementation: Both GPT-OSS scripts explicitly set native reasoning_effort via the template; default medium can be preconfigured using SATD_REASONING_EFFORT.
R29.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R31.implementation: RunAudit records source identities, sample/stage seeds, full generation configs, template/prompt hashes, installed versions and actual checkpoint metadata; no runtime was executed. Future run directories include microseconds and reject existing destinations.
R31.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R32.implementation: Independent stage1_coarse_pred report and confusion matrix are added; legacy coarse report is explicitly final_fine_aggregated_coarse.
R32.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

R33.implementation: Original fallback policy metrics remain primary, while pre-fallback labels/status and additional failure-as-error metrics are preserved.
R33.historical_status: Not re-evaluated. The revision does not establish how much any previous paper result was affected.

fallback_policy_boundary.tree: Preserve FALLBACK_FINE_BY_COARSE for a valid coarse stage; if coarse is invalid preserve original Data Conf default. Original policy predictions remain primary.
fallback_policy_boundary.binary: The binary family uses its existing final Data Conf policy. Tree category-specific defaults are intentionally distinct, not silently unified.
fallback_policy_boundary.additional_metrics: Pre-fallback failures are separately counted and failure-as-error metrics are additional; no historical result is overwritten.
